author: reek
body: Bounded signatures, stage B (postcondition): an out-of-range result traps before the return. clamp-ret's declared return is bounded 0..15 and its body passes through the plain-Integer parameter 99, so the return guard traps with UD2.

author: reek
body: The __narrow is load-bearing and this test did not have it until 2026-07-27, which is why it stopped compiling. CDX2051 refuses a bounded return whose value has an unproven range rather than inserting a check nobody asked for; __narrow is the request, and it traps at runtime exactly as its diagnostic promises.
